purpose: Reviewer-reproducible activation and behavior cases for the OpenAI Plugins Directory listing. Synthetic, public fixtures; no account, repository, credential or network service is required beyond the host itself.
how_to_run: Install the plugin, start a NEW conversation per case, send each turn in order exactly as written, and compare the final answer with expected_behavior and expected_output. Explicit cases select PromptingCraft.com from the composer: $promptcraft in Codex (observed); @ selection in ChatGPT is the documented route but has not been observed for this plugin yet. Natural-language cases must not mention the plugin. Where a case lists a primary outcome and an acceptable alternative, either passes.

cases.fixture: None. The task is stated in the turn.
turns: [Select PromptingCraft.com] Prepare a Codex prompt: our Node.js worker returns HTTP 200 when the request body is malformed JSON. Return HTTP 400 for malformed JSON, keep existing responses for valid payloads, add no new dependencies. Implementation is approved; deployment is not.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill activates, extracts the task contract, writes a draft, critiques it once and finalizes. It does not execute the task or claim to have run code.
cases.expected_output: Primary: one copyable code block containing the complete Codex prompt with the 400-for-malformed-JSON goal, unchanged valid-payload behavior, no new dependencies, implementation allowed and deployment not authorized. Acceptable alternative: the no-change sentence with the task body echoed exactly, because the request already states goal, constraints, authority and a checkable outcome. Freshness is labeled outside the block. (Revised 2026-10-12 after the first native run chose no-change, which SKILL.md section 3 permits.)

cases.fixture: None. Decisions are established in turn 1.
turns: We are discussing a CSV export bug in a team dashboard. Names containing commas are split across columns. We agreed: keep the columns and order exactly id,name,status; reuse the existing export action; no new dependencies; implementation is approved but deployment is not. Just acknowledge for now.
Prepare a Codex prompt for this.
cases.expected_behavior: Turn 1 is an ordinary acknowledgement without prompt composition. Turn 2 activates the skill without repeating questions about decisions already made.
cases.expected_output: One copyable Codex prompt that preserves the literal column list id,name,status in that order, the existing export action, no new dependencies, implementation approved and deployment not authorized.

turns:
Review and improve this Claude Code prompt without changing its scope:

Fix the failing date-parsing test in utils/dates.test.ts. Also refactor the whole utils folder, upgrade all dependencies, and write a blog post about it. Be extremely careful. Be extremely careful. Do not change the public API of formatDate.
cases.expected_behavior: The user asks not to change the scope, so the refactor, dependency upgrade and blog post stay in scope and are not dropped. The skill removes the duplicated caution, keeps the formatDate invariant unconditional and adds no new requirements. Flagging the breadth of the extra tasks as a question is acceptable; silently removing them is not. (Revised 2026-10-12: the first version treated the extra tasks as scope creep, contradicting the user's explicit 'without changing its scope'.)
cases.expected_output: One copyable revised prompt that keeps all four requested tasks, the formatDate public-API invariant verbatim and no duplicated caution, with no new mandatory gates or mechanisms; brief findings outside the block.

cases.fixture: The task body below. If the host lets you turn off web search or browsing, do so to exercise the unavailable-guidance path; otherwise the case still checks the no-change outcome and honest freshness labels.
turns:
Review this complete Codex task. If it is already suitable, keep it unchanged:

Fix the CSV export so names containing commas are quoted per RFC 4180. Keep the columns and order id,name,status. Add a regression test for a name containing a comma. Do not add dependencies. Implementation is approved; do not deploy.
cases.expected_behavior: After contract extraction and critique, the skill chooses no-change instead of rewriting. When live guidance cannot be retrieved it says that guidance is dated cached or unavailable and does not claim a retrieval that did not happen.
cases.expected_output: The sentence "The original prompt is already suitable. No material revision is necessary." Echoing the task body is optional; if echoed, it is exactly as supplied in one code block. Freshness is labeled live-verified with a date, dated cached, or unavailable, matching what actually happened.

turns: Prepare a Claude Code prompt. Investigate why the billing export drops rows. Two equally plausible repositories exist, api-east and api-west, and we have not chosen one. This is investigation only; no edits.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill does not pick a repository. It asks one deciding question or produces a short blocked handoff that keeps both repositories open and preserves the investigation-only, no-edit boundary.
cases.expected_output: Primary: one deciding question about which repository to target. Acceptable alternative: one copyable blocked prompt that lists both repositories as an unresolved choice and states investigation only with no edits. Picking one repository fails the case.
